description: Worked as a doctor before specialising in internal medicine and in prevention and public health (FMH specialist titles obtained in 1998).
Served as Cantonal Doctor for the canton of Ticino, responsible for public health functions in the cantonal administration.

organization: Swiss Medical Association (FMH, Foederatio Medicorum Helveticorum)
description: Vice-president of the Swiss Medical Association, the professional body of Swiss physicians.
Member of the National Council for the canton of Ticino (FDP). From 2015 chaired the National Council's Social Security and Health Committee; previously FDP parliamentary group leader.
Began his political career in the legislative authority of the Ticino municipality of Collina d'Oro.

role: Federal Councillor, Head of the Federal Department of Foreign Affairs (FDFA/DFAE)
description: Elected to the Federal Council on 20 September 2017; heads the Federal Department of Foreign Affairs since 1 November 2017. President of the Swiss Confederation in 2022; Vice-President in 2021 and 2026.
